# OhMyGame

> An open-source local-first game creation app and its browser game SDK.

## SDK authors

- [SDK README](packages/sdk/README.md): Install and use `@ohmygame/sdk`.
- [SDK AI guide](packages/sdk/llms.txt): SDK-oriented navigation and non-negotiable boundaries.
- [SDK agent guide](packages/sdk/AGENT_GUIDE.md): Detailed rules for agents writing a game.
- [SDK starter example](examples/sdk-starter/README.md): Minimal browser project using the published SDK.

## Platform and contributors

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): Map from product areas to code and guides.
- [Multiplayer integration](docs/multiplayer.md): Local rooms, rules, and hosted deployment.
- [External agents](docs/external-agents.md): The desktop app's MCP server, separate from the SDK.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, checks, and contribution workflow.
